'''Indrek Martinson''' (1937– 14 November 2009) was an [[Estonia]]n-born Swedish physicist.<ref name="osa.org">{{cite web |title=Indrek Martinson |url=https://www.osa.org/en-us/about_osa/newsroom/obituaries/earlier/indrekmartinson/ |website=osa.org |access-date=10 July 2021}}</ref>

In 1971 he defended his doctoral thesis at [[Stockholm University]]. He taught at [[Lund University]] ([[Emeritus Professor]]).<ref name="osa.org" />

His main field of research was accelerator-based [[atomic physics]].<ref name="osa.org" />

==Awards==
* 2001: [[Order of the White Star]], IV class.<ref name="president.ee">{{cite web |title=Teenetemärkide kavalerid: Indrek Martinson|url=https://www.president.ee/et/vabariik/teenetemargid/kavaler/3535/indrek-martinson |website=www.president.ee |access-date=10 July 2021}}</ref>
